### 接口说明
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

<props="china">- 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解云存储网关产品的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=5176.144914.752642.btn2.1fea7d70I6QIr5&aly_as=C81M1m5N#/hcs_sgw/detail)。</props>

### Description

Before you call this operation, note the following:

<props="china">

- Make sure that you understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=5176.144914.752642.btn2.1fea7d70I6QIr5\&aly_as=C81M1m5N#/hcs_sgw/detail) of Cloud Storage Gateway.

</props>

<props="intl">

- Make sure that you understand the billing methods and pricing of Cloud Storage Gateway.

</props>

- You can use the purchase URL or renewal URL returned by this operation to purchase or renew the gateway.
